scope: Obligation R10 of the rank-deficient route, the equidimensional degenerate case, is PROVED: when finrank V = finrank W the fibre dimension is 0, H^0-nullity of a slice means the slice is EMPTY, and almost every level of a C1 map contains no critical point at all. With R0 through R9 that is eleven of the route's thirteen numbered items. THIS IS NOT A SARD THEOREM AND IT IS NOT PROGRESS ON THE ROUTE: it is the case n = m alone, and R0 was already proved independently by the stratification route. The same round proves the diagnostic N2 FALSE AS WRITTEN and proves the repaired statement. N1 remains unproved. No hole migrated, no certificate added. The log-concave Cheeger-Buser line belongs to collaborator Wang Haocheng and was not touched.

main_results.R10: ae_critical_inter_levelSet_eq_empty: for a C1 map u : V -> W with finrank V = finrank W, for almost every t the set {x | fderiv R u x is not surjective} intersected with {x | u x = t} is EMPTY. The fibre dimension is k = 0 and mu_H[0]-nullity of a slice degenerates to emptiness, so this is the n = m reading of R0.
main_results.measure_image_critical_eq_zero: the IMAGE of the critical set of an equidimensional C1 map is Lebesgue-null in W. Mathlib's self-map lemma addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_det_fderivWithin_eq_zero is transported along the repository's isometryEquivOfFinrankEq by PREcomposing u with the inverse isometry rather than postcomposing it, so the image already lives in W and the null set itself never has to be moved.
main_results.det_eq_zero_of_not_surjective: a non-surjective endomorphism of a finite-dimensional real space has vanishing determinant. Mathlib has only the converse (LinearMap.range_lt_top_of_det_eq_zero); this direction goes through injectivity, which is equivalent to surjectivity only in finite dimension.

boundary_between_R10_and_Sard.sard_is: a statement about the measure of the set of critical VALUES of a map R^n -> R^m
boundary_between_R10_and_Sard.what_is_proved: the case n = m alone, where a singular differential contracts volume and Mathlib already supplies the self-map statement
boundary_between_R10_and_Sard.what_is_not: for n > m the critical values of a merely C1 map can have positive measure (Whitney) and nothing here says otherwise
boundary_between_R10_and_Sard.the_direct_hole: FunctionalInequalities.Analysis.sard in KLS/WIP/AnalyticPrerequisites.lean: a real-valued map on a domain of ANY dimension n, at regularity C^n. UNTOUCHED, and its status is unchanged.
boundary_between_R10_and_Sard.entire_overlap: finrank V = 1, recorded by r10_reaches_only_dimension_one and carried out by sard_dimension_one_recovered; that case was already proved unconditionally by Analysis.sard_of_finrank_le_one, from the same Mathlib lemma
boundary_between_R10_and_Sard.not_a_step_towards_R0: the route exploration already recorded that R10 is not on the way to R0; R0 was proved independently by the stratification route, which never specializes to n = m. R10 is an after-the-fact consistency check.
boundary_between_R10_and_Sard.independence_of_the_check: Analysis/EquidimensionalSard.lean imports no part of the rank-deficient route (local import closure 18 modules), so equidimensional_R0_of_R10 and equidimensional_R10_of_R0 compare two genuinely independent proofs; in the case n = m the two statements are equivalent because mu_H[0] of a nonempty set is at least 1

N2_is_false.route_statement: volume S != 0 -> 0 < r -> mu_H[((finrank V - r : N) : R)] S = top, with finrank V - r a TRUNCATED natural subtraction
N2_is_false.counterexample: finrank V = 0. The space is a single point, the only set of nonzero volume is that point, the truncated exponent is 0 rather than negative, and mu_H[0] of a singleton is 1, not top.
N2_is_false.universe_note: route_N2_is_false refutes the Type instance of the route proposition; the route's Type* version implies that instance, so refuting it refutes the route statement
N2_is_false.repair_proved: ExponentObstructionAudit.hausdorffMeasure_finrank_sub_eq_top_of_finrank_pos, which is N2 with 0 < finrank V added
N2_is_false.repair_is_free_on_the_route: wherever the route appeals to N2, r is a rank with 1 <= r < finrank W <= finrank V, so the dimension is positive already; recorded as N2_repair_is_free_on_the_route

boundary_cases_checked.zero_dimensional: both spaces trivial: every linear map is surjective, the critical set is empty
boundary_cases_checked.constant_map: the derivative vanishes identically, so with a positive-dimensional target every point is critical (constant_map_critical_everywhere shows the case is not vacuous); the conclusion holds because the whole image is a single point
boundary_cases_checked.regular_map: n = m with an everywhere invertible differential: the critical set is empty and the conclusion holds for EVERY level, not merely almost every one
